semantic_review: Existing Transfers questions focus on named player moves and transfer source/destination. This draft instead uses 22 FIFA TMS market observations for calendar year 2025. Targeted open-PR and Daily searches found no Global Transfer Report 2025, sell-on, 24,558 or equivalent observations.
comparison_review: Only identical metrics and frames: Portugal 774 vs England 769 incoming transfers; Germany USD 1.28bn vs Italy USD 1.20bn spending. No gender, event, league or distance mixing.
limits: Normalization plus observation keys and targeted Main/PR/Daily searches.
